subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The vendor said that the apples were of __superior__ quality.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **'Superior**' means better than usual or than somebody/something else; having a more important position.(बेहतर)

 
 
• **Example **-The new model is **superior **to every other car on the road.
 
 
 
• **'Inferior' **means low or lower in social position, importance, quality, etc.(निचला, हीन)
 
 
• **Example **- The quality of this product is **inferior **to the original.

 
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the antonym of **'Superior'** is **'Inferior'**.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is **'Inferior'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences.

 
• **Small **(छोटा) - Not large, number, amount, minor significance or consequence etc.

 
 
• **Example **- He built a **small **model of the Eiffel Tower.
 
 
 
• **Distasteful **(अप्रिय, बेस्वाद) - unpleasant or causing offence
 
 
• **Example **- Her behaviour at the party was considered **distasteful **by many.
 
 
 
• **Excellent **(उत्कृष्ट) -very good; of high quality; outstanding; superior.
 
 
• **Example **- She gave an **excellent **performance in the play.
